//: Semantic-diff lines that the MJML migration is expected to produce. The report classifies any diff line matching one of these as explained, and anything else as an unexplained regression. Each entry needs a reason so the list stays reviewable rather than becoming a place to silence failures.

expected.reason: The footer year was hardcoded per template (seven said 2023, four said 2024). It is now injected by the render layer, so it can never go stale again.
Security fix: the old substituter escaped HTML but never checked URL schemes, so a javascript: URL in a link field reached the recipient's href. The url helper now allows only http/https/mailto.
Same security fix, seen from the link side: these hrefs are now empty rather than executable.
Counterpart of the entry above - the sanitised href renders empty.

classReminder and teachingReminder hardcoded https://portal.gbstem.org in their footer while every other template read app.link. They now read app.link too, and their two callers (remindStudents, remindInstructor) were updated to pass it.
